items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: I worked two, three different places, Pines and Blanches, Miss B. Nichols, Lucille Wilson.

ctx.x: Lucille Agnes. I used to work for Pines and Blanches. I worked two, three different places, Pines and Blanches, Miss B. Nichols, Lucille Wilson.
These were all the madams, huh?
